inspiration: Search window with a compact four-column item table, row-level tooltips showing slot and level, and a name filter (addons/find/find.lua lines 139-170; the filter input is on line 140). A clean pattern for an item or monster finder in our HUD.
Immediate-mode tool windows built with imgui calls (addons/find/find.lua, addons/libs/imgui.lua): a dev-only overlay style for our debug panel, kept out of the player HUD.

Per-build pointer tables stored as ini files named by build id (config/pointers/). The technique is to keep version-specific values in data files so one code base can support several builds. Not the values themselves.
Version-scoped module folders (addons/libs/daoc/<build>/): one set of modules per build with a shared core library. A layout we can reuse for per-content-pack modules.
A live packet or event logger shown as a scrolling window (addons/packetlogger/packetlogger.lua, name read only). Idea: an in-game event feed for playtests.
Sample add-on scripts (addons/example/example.lua, addons/example_packets/example_packets.lua) as a starter kit for community content. Idea: ship a minimal template with every new feature.

briefs.label: Searchable finder panel
briefs.why: A searchable table with hover detail finds any item quickly, and the same pattern works for any list of things in the world.
briefs.keep: a name filter; a compact table; hover detail
briefs.change: our own column set and icons; on a 375-wide phone, a card list instead of a table; a warm theme
briefs.fit: silhouette at 375 wide: card list works; signature behaviour: filter then hover; signature sound: none in donor. There is no creature, item or armour art in this donor, so the brief is UI-level only. Rule: recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy. Category-level only (class D donor).

briefs.label: Debug event feed
briefs.why: A scrolling feed of recent events lets a tester see what happened without leaving the game.
briefs.keep: a scrolling log window; newest entry at the bottom
briefs.change: a dev-only toggle; our own styling; event filters by category
briefs.fit: silhouette: n/a (panel); signature behaviour: live scroll; signature sound: none in donor. Rule: recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy. Category-level only (class D donor).
